opening.argument: The offer is presented as a risk-free home business while soliciting viewers with the prospect of earning “$200 or even $ thousand dollars daily.” That earnings pitch is tied to a named successful team and a network-marketing leader, not merely to an explanation of Bitcoin mining. The presentation further claims that mined Bitcoin was paid out “100% to the BitClub partners,” connecting participation to partner payouts. Finally, the frame’s “Join the BITCOIN Revolution” call to action reinforces that viewers are being urged to join. Taken together, these are recruitment-oriented promotional claims built around extraordinary earnings, network-marketing leadership, and a tiered participation structure.
